Gideon, I've replied in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

- **First report:** you reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, company time (CDT). You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **The guard in the meantime:** your 10:42 message said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Nothing in the channel shows that changing until 11:03 AM, when Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You posted at 11:07–11:08 that both lanes were working. That puts the clipboard in use for roughly 21–25 minutes.

Mateo also noted six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. I only have what was posted in the channel, so I can't say whether the guard kept using the clipboard after kiosk 1 came back.
